Monta un deck de Magic con imágenes de S: Build a Magic deck with images from Scryfall or your own, design your own proxies and get them as a print-ready PDF. This tour shows what each area does; you can replay it any time with the help button at the top.
Deck: la lista, las hojas y la exportaci: Deck: the list, the sheets and the export. Design: the card editor, to make your own proxies. Library: all your saved decks.
Haz clic para cambiarlo. El deck se guar: Click to change it. The deck saves itself while you work: on the right you'll see when it's saved.
Pega aquí la lista, de Moxfield, Arena,: Paste the list here, from Moxfield, Arena, MTGO or as plain text (“4 Lightning Bolt”, with its set and number if you like). “Load list” looks the cards up on Scryfall and replaces the deck; “Add” puts them at the end. At the top, “Sets” lets you pick cards from a whole set and “Example” puts in a list to try.
Añade las fichas solas o detéctalas desp: Add tokens automatically or detect them later, import a deck from an Archidekt URL, upload your own card images or a back, and choose the card language, which printing is used and the preview quality.
Añade cartas o páginas, ordena el deck s: Add cards or pages, sort the deck automatically, hide double-faced cards, see the backs or each card's info, open the stats (curve, mana, draw odds, prices and legality) and change the zoom (Ctrl + wheel works too).
Así saldrá el papel. Arrastra las cartas: This is how the paper will come out. Drag cards to reorder them or drop images from your computer on them. Right-click a card to change its variant, edit it, link it, design it, mark it as optional or sideboard, pin it… Ctrl or Shift selects several; Ctrl+Z undoes.
«Exportar PDF» crea el fichero para impr: “Export PDF” creates the file to print. The three dots copy the list for Moxfield, Arena or MTGO, save it as .txt or save the deck with its images (.pbdeck) to take it to another computer.
Papel y orientación, tamaño de carta (63: Paper and orientation, card size (63 × 88, 63.5 × 88.9 or 65 × 90 mm, which fills a sleeve exactly), spacing and bleed, cut guides, double-sided printing, darkened edges, row alignment for duplex and print presets. Everything is saved with the deck and undone with Ctrl+Z.
El idioma de la app, el tema y el aspect: The app's language, the theme and look, card names in other languages and updates.
Este botón vuelve a abrir el tutorial de: This button opens the tutorial of the screen you're on again. Design and Library have their own.
Aquí haces tus propias proxies: la app p: Here you make your own proxies: the app draws each card with its frame, its texts and your art, in the language you choose, and the PDF prints it at its size.
Elige la carta que quieres diseñar; cada: Pick the card you want to design; each one says whether it has no design, is a draft or is ready. Search by name at the top, and Alt+← and Alt+→ take you to the previous or the next one.
«Renumerar» numera las cartas por el ord: “Renumber” numbers the cards in deck order, “Design the deck” does them all at once, “Export images” saves them as PNG, “Collections” defines a shared style (frame, footer, settings) and “Fonts, frames and symbols” adds fonts, frame packs and symbols.
La carta tal como se imprimirá. Elige el: The card as it will be printed. Choose the design language, switch between parts or faces (split cards, Aftermath cards and double-faced cards have two, each with its own art) and turn on the safe area. Drag the art to move it and use the wheel to zoom it.
Lo que conviene revisar: textos que no c: What's worth checking: texts that don't fit, missing symbols, cards with no official text in that language… Click to see them; some are fixed with one button.
Carta: estilo y colección. Textos: nombr: Card: style and collection. Texts: name, type, rules and flavor in each language. Art: upload, paste, get from Scryfall or crop each part's art and frame it. Frame: pack, color and rules box. Footer: number, set and artist. Fine tuning: height and size of each text, radii and more.
Marca la carta como lista para imprimir,: Mark the card as ready to print, create a variant with another design, save, or save and go to the next one. Changes don't reach the deck until you save.
Todos tus decks, que se guardan solos mi: All your decks, which save themselves while you work. Click one to open it.
Busca por nombre, carta o nota (Ctrl+F);: Search by name, card or note (Ctrl+F); filter by colors, format, language, favourites or designed cards; sort, group and switch between grid and list.
Crea un deck vacío, importa un .pbdeck (: Create an empty deck, import a .pbdeck (a deck with its images) or free the space of images no deck uses any more.
Ordena tus decks con etiquetas propias (: Organize your decks with your own tags (format, language, status…) and favourites. Ctrl + click picks several tags at once.
Cada deck enseña sus colores, cartas, pr: Each deck shows its colors, cards, price and languages. Right-click or use the three dots to open, rename, duplicate, tag, set the language, see properties (notes and cover), export a .pbdeck or delete. Ctrl or Shift selects several to act on all of them.
